caption: The drawing depicts a small, rectangular wooden table with a simple design. The table has four straight, tapering legs, and a medium-brown coloration. There is a single drawer in the upper section of the table with a small, round knob centered on the drawer front. Below the drawer, there is an open shelf supported by the four legs. The wood grain is visible throughout the table, and the background is a plain, light beige color. The table is shown from an angle such that both the front and the right side, as well as the top and lower shelf, are visible. There are no additional objects or decorations present in the drawing.
title: Shaker Table
